judgment.notes: Standard Lebesgue measure/integral on each real coordinate space, with product normalization and the dimension-zero singleton of mass one. This covers coordinate slicing when n=1. It introduces notation and measure normalization, without granting integrability or Fubini.

Euclidean inner product/norm, componentwise derivatives, coordinate Laplacian and Frobenius gradient square match the original conventions. Indices range from 1 to n and times are positive. The smoothness guard H002 is explicit; it is a direct input of every R using this notation. No PDE identity is built into the definition.

Compared the complete problem.md (including its supplied proof) with the selected target, spec and P. H001–H006 preserve positive integer dimensions, joint smoothness on ℝ^n×(0,∞), fixed unit q, the pointwise unit constraint, pointwise existential normal acceleration without scalar regularity, and ∀0<s<t∃compact C∀r∈[s,t] common support of u−q. Parameters contain only ambient data. The disclosed, fixed support interpretation is preserved; it is not attributed to an Evans correction. P retains integrability, differentiability, zero derivative at every positive time, and the exact energy without 1/2 or any time-zero assertion. Constancy is the stated consequence in the supplied proof. The five exported stages preserve that proof route.
